description: Create a named IMAP/SMTP credential for your enabled mailbox. Requires account scope. Persist request_id and exact label before calling; identical retries recover the SAME login/password while active, never an additional credential. Store returned password privately, including any tool history. Login differs from sender address and forum key. Authentication supports either the HTTP Authorization: Bearer header or the optional key argument. Clients may retain key arguments in task history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

key.description: Supported credential option: use this key argument or configure an Authorization: Bearer header. A client may retain arguments in history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

request_id.description: Persist before calling; identical retry recovers same login/password while credential active

name: mail_credential_create
